eligibility.not_open: The activity is not open for registration
eligibility.membership_type_not_allowed: Your membership type does not give access to this activity
eligibility.no_price_for_membership_type: No price is available for your membership type: please contact the club
eligibility.birth_date_required: This activity has an age restriction: add your date of birth on My profile
eligibility.already_registered: You are already registered for this activity

activities.title: Activities
activities.info: Activities are events, courses, workshops, or competitions that members can register for. Each activity can have modalities (variants), pricing tiers, and eligibility rules.
activities.name: Name
activities.allowedTypesHint: With none ticked the activity is open to every member. Tick types and only those members can register.

actions.confirmPublish: Publish this activity? It will be visible to members.
actions.confirmPublishDescription: Members will be able to see it and register from the portal.
actions.confirmArchiveDescription: It stops appearing in listings and takes no new registrations. The ones it already has are kept.
actions.confirmCancel: Cancel this activity? This cannot be undone.
actions.confirmCancelDescription: Its registrations are cancelled and the activity does not open again.
actions.confirmDeleteDescription: It is deleted along with its modalities, prices and registrations. To retire it and keep the history, archive it instead.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.name: Modality Name
modalities.confirmDeleteDescription: Its prices are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.

prices.title: Prices
prices.name: Price Name
prices.confirmDeleteDescription: Registrations already charged at this price are unaffected.
prices.allowedTypesHint: Leave all unchecked for this price to apply to every membership type. Members whose type is not selected will not be offered it.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.confirmDeleteDescription: It can no longer be redeemed. Registrations that already used it are unaffected.

consents.title: Consents
consents.confirmDeleteDescription: It stops being asked for at registration. This cannot be undone.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.name: Attachment Name
attachments.confirmDeleteDescription: It stops being asked for at registration. This cannot be undone.

coverImage.title: Cover Image
coverImage.dragOrClick: Click to upload a cover image
coverImage.maxSizeHint: Max {size}MB. JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF.
coverImage.confirmRemoveDescription: The activity will show with no image. You can upload another one at any time.
coverImage.invalidType: File type not allowed. Use JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF.

registration.confirmCancelDescription: The member is no longer registered and their place is freed.
registration.alreadyRegistered: You are already registered for this activity
registration.noMyActivities: You haven't registered for any activities yet
registration.confirmWithoutPaymentDescription: The registration is confirmed and its receipt cancelled: the member will not have to pay it. Who did it is recorded.
registration.keepPaymentDescription: Cancelling it puts the amount on the list of refunds due. If the club keeps the payment, tick this.
registration.pendingNotice: Your seat is held. The registration is confirmed once the payment is recorded.
registration.expiredNotice: This registration was cancelled because it was not paid in time.
registration.pendingCreated: Seat held: pay the receipt to confirm it

legacy.tooltip: This activity uses the previous flow: registrations are confirmed at once and the receipt is collected afterwards. New activities hold the seat as pending until it is paid. This cannot be changed; activities you create from now on use the new flow.

payment.title: Payment
payment.legacyNotice: This activity confirms registrations at once and the receipt is collected afterwards. It cannot be changed.
payment.methodsHint: The member pays the receipt from "My receipts", and their seat is pending until then. A paid activity needs at least one to be published.
payment.unavailable: Not available: no active payment provider or no club IBAN
payment.pendingEmailOff: The "Registration pending payment" email is switched off: members will not know they have to pay. Switch it on in Settings › Communications.
payment.autoCancelNeedsEmails: To switch on automatic cancellation, first switch on in Settings › Communications: {templates}.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.info: Cancelled registrations whose payment has to be returned. The refund is made from the gateway's dashboard (Stripe, Redsys) or by hand; here it is only marked as done.
refunds.confirmMarkReturnedDescription: Do it once the money has been returned. Who and when is recorded.
